note: THE WALK, re-driven at PR #3014's head after the card's own Continue landed on a SETUP gate in a
conversation and after the shipped recorder learned to write a `decided` record of this kind as an
ABSENCE instance. Twelve cells, light and dark, on the two hosts a real run can reach; `site_widget`
and `page_gate_region` are composition-only in the contract itself and no picture of them is asked for.
WHAT CHANGED IN THE PLAN AT THIS HEAD, and why:
· the setup answer presses [data-action="submit-hitl-screen"] — THE CARD'S OWN Continue — because
the renderer's own submit is no longer drawn inside the fields region on a conversation host;
· the mid-run chat steps can no longer wait on the card's own Continue to tell the two gates apart,
because the setup gate draws one too. They wait on the region that does NOT declare
`data-send-affordance="card"`, which is exactly the mid-run gate (`cardOwnsTheSetupSend` excludes it).
export WALK_ANSWER=<the reader's own answer to the setup question>

steps.why: The conversation the run was started from, while the run is parked at the SETUP question.

cells.requires: SECTION I of the ratified base page at the contract's pin, THE INPUT RULE, verbatim: 'The rule, wherever a card meets a chat box — Exactly one primary input is drawn per conversation, and it is the chat box. Any field a card carries is drawn subordinate to it. Where there is no chat box to be subordinate to — the run page and the review page — the card's field is the only input there is and takes the primary treatment instead. The hierarchy is between the two inputs, not a fixed look for either one.' and 'No box of its own, no fill, no send. A ruled baseline under a mono label — it reads as a field on the card, not as somewhere to start typing.' Plus PLAN: Agents Lifecycle (B) — "an agent's HITL screen is fields with a Continue button" and 'A run at a moment shows its card on every host'. Plus The pull request's own words — 'the fields the step asks for and a Continue that answers them' — and its newest section: on chat_thread the setup gate's fields region holds NO button and the card's OWN Continue stands outside it (cardOwnsTheSetupSend, data-send-affordance="card"). For THIS cell: the card in the conversation the run was started from, at the SETUP gate (setup-<runId>, field `idea`, @cinatra-ai/agent-builder:schema-field-fallback). The fields region is SUBORDINATE — no enclosing box, no fill, no raised ground, a ruled baseline under a mono label — it carries NO button at all, and the card's own [data-action="submit-hitl-screen"] is drawn OUTSIDE it. One primary input in the conversation, and it is the chat box.

steps.why: THE PRESS, on its own. The reader presses THE CARD'S OWN Continue ([data-action="submit-hitl-screen"]) on the mid-run gate. It observes NO cell, because the settled reading is not instantaneous: the run resumes, materialises its artifact and completes, and only then does the card leave the transcript. A step that shot at a fixed delay after the press photographed a card that was still on screen, and the recorder refused the record for it — correctly. So the press and the reading are two steps, and the reading waits on the card that takes the slot.

The settled reading of the mid-run gate: the run has resumed and completed, this kind draws nothing at all, and the review gate's card has taken the slot in the same turn. The step waits on THAT card rather than on a clock.
